$comment: Acceptance test groups shared by testacc-windows.yml and testacc-lab-container.yml, consumed by .github/scripts/Invoke-AccTests.ps1 and .github/scripts/testacc-plan.py. Each `run` is a `go test -run` regexp (RE2: no lookahead). Families are prefix-matched so new tests of an existing resource land in the right group automatically. The catch-all group runs every ^TestAcc test that no other group claims; its skip pattern is derived from the other groups, so it never needs manual upkeep. If it starts finding tests, give the new resource family its own group. `dedicated`: machine-global work (DISM) that always gets a runner of its own. `githubHosted: false`: tests that can only skip on windows-latest (they cost minutes there for nothing), run by testacc-lab-container only. `github`: how testacc-plan.py packs tests into testacc-windows.yml runners (target seconds and max tests per runner, cost of a test missing from testacc-timings.json, families the public-key smoke lane runs).
